Overview

Daegu is a city in DGU with a population of 2,445,000. A historic industrial city in southeastern Korea, famous for its textile industry, traditional medicine market, and hot summers. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
